title: Meadow: build the prototype's scene, seeded per person and year, 60 fps at 366 flowers, three PRs
context: The prototype's Meadow Scene replaces the live flat meadow with a generated landscape (mountains, waterfall, lake, stream, conifer wings, one procedural flower per day, bees, butterflies, fireflies), a year picker, a past-year study, full screen and two tabs. The live app had no per-user identity to seed from and no per-day entry counts, and the earlier dark-mode spec had made Fast-forward and Now debug-only.
options: Prototype's new scene, judged against Meadow Scene
Keep today's flat meadow and add only the new UI
Seed from a meadow key saved in settings
Seed from the journal's first day id
Ship Play the day to everyone
Keep Play the day and Now debug-only
outcome: Owner chose, 2026-09-29: the prototype's new scene; a random meadow key saved with the settings and mixed with the year; Play the day and Now stay debug-only (the study's time slider ships); 60 fps at 366 flowers on the Note10+ and the Mac in every view, day and night; past years titled by weather; nothing deferred; month buttons for keyboard and screen readers; one shared entry-count query; scene appears within 1 s with no frame over 100 ms; three PRs merged in order (data, scene, page); both light and dark themes. Full list in docs/specs/meadow.decisions.md.
